tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i brgyud pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje chos/ /rgyal ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /rgyal sras thu bo nā ro ta pa'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /gsang chen slob bshad 'dzin pa'i pham mthing pa/ /gsang mdzod kun gyi gter gyur shes rab brtsegs/ /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mal lo'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /rdo rje 'chang chen bla chen sa skya pa/ /rdo rje'i sras mchog rje btsun bsod nams rtse/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan grags pa'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /sa skya paṇa chen gangs can mkhas pa'i rje/ /sa gsum skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan 'phags pa'i mchog /sa skya'i bstan 'dzin zhang ston dkon mchog dpal/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /grub pa'i dbang po na bza' brag phug pa/ /grub mchog mkhas pa'i ded dpon chos kyi rje/ /sgrub rigs snyan brgyud mnga' bdag yar klungs pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rgyal ba mchog /bdag nyid chen po 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan/ /bdag chen chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun rdo rings pa/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin blo gsal dbang / /bka' brgyud gsang chen smra ba mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /rig sngags 'chang ba bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang / /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan dpal/ /rigs kyi gtso bo rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag zhwa lu ba/

/dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo mkhyen rab rje/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag po rnam gnyis la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i ded dpon rdo rje 'dzin/ /snyan brgyud mnga' bdag rmor chen rdo rje 'chang / /snyan brgyud spel mkhas legs pa'i 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag kun dga' blo gros dang / /rig 'dzin chen po bstan 'dzin lhun grub zhabs/ /rig gnas mthar son blo gsal phun tshogs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /rnam mkhyen bla ma bzhi yi thugs kyi sras/ /rnam mang 'gro la brtse ba'i lhag bsam can/ /rnam 'dren 'khor lo'i mgon po mkhyen rab rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /zab gsang snyan brgyud gdams pa ma lus pa'i/ /zab don mdzod 'dzin gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang / /zab lam mnga' bdag rig 'dzin maṅga'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid/ /dngos su gzigs pa'i dpal ldan gu ṇa pa/ /dngos grub mchog stsol rje btsun ya sha'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /rnam mang ma gyur 'gro ba'i mgon gcig pu/ /rnam 'dren grub pa'i dbang phyug pradzñā'i mtshan/ /rnam gsum 'dus zhal rje btsun nā ga'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'khon rigs sa skya pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin dam pa lce btsun mkhyen brtse'i dbang / /bstan pa'i gsal byed kun dga'i mtshan can la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /gsang chen rgyud sde'i mthar thug gsang mtha'i bcud/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i nye lam gdams pa'i mchog /gsang mdzod ston mkhas rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ ༈ /dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi/

/ba dan dkar pos bskyod pa'i las 'bras kyi/ /blang dor mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /bslu med skyabs gnas gtsug gi nor bur bsten/ /mar gyur 'gro ba'i don chen snying la zhugs/ /rdor sems bdud rtsis nyes pa'i dri ma bkrus/ /rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rjes skyong bar shog /yid 'ong rgyal yum phyi yi rnal 'byor ma/ /bam̐ yig nang gi rdo rje btsun mo mchog /sems nyid stong gsal gsang ba'i mkha' spyod yum/ /rang zhal mthong ba'i rtse dgas rol bar shog /snod kyi 'jig rten e yig gzhal med khang / /bcud kyi sems can bam̐ yig rnal 'byor ma/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /cir snang dag pa'i snang bar 'char bar shog /de ltar phyogs dang zla ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /nam zhig dus na dga' ma byi ru'i mdog /li khri'i skra grol dmar ser mig g.yo mas/ /mngon sum rig 'dzin grong du 'khrid par shog /sin+dhūr laṅka li ya'i sdong bur bcas/ /ro ldan gnas su bsgrubs shing yul kun tu/ /nyul bas gang gi mdzod spur 'khyil ris can/ /'phos pa'i mdzes mas mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog /nang gi phag mos gzung 'dzin 'khri shing bcom/ /mchog gi dhū tir zhugs pa'i gar mkhan ma/ /tshangs pa'i sgo nas sprin lam dbyings su thon/ /khrag 'thung dpa' bor 'khyud cing rol bar shog /lte ba'i pad+mor rlung lnga'i ti la ka /rtse gcig bsgom pa'i kha sbyor rnal 'byor gyis/ /lus sems rtsa la dri bzhon zhugs pa yi/ /bde ba mchog gis bdag rgyud tshim par shog /tha mal 'od kyi gtum mo mdzes ldan ma/ /dhū tir 'dzum dkar bzhad pa'i rol rtsed kyis/ /haṃ yig gzhon nu yongs su mnyes byas nas/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sa thob shog /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis/ /stong gsal brjod du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang / /zung 'jug blo 'das rang sems rnal 'byor ma/

/rang ngo shes nas rtag tu skyong bar shog /rtsa rlung thig le e wam̐ dbyings su thim/ /sems nyid bde chen chos sku'i dpal thob nas/ /bgrang yas gzugs sku'i rnam rol dpag med kyis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro 'di skyong bar shog /ces 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu jo bo nā ro ta pa mngon sum du rjes su bzung ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod du grags pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa lam gyi rim pa'i smon lam dang bcas pa mchog gi pad+mo bzhad pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs kyis ring nas bskyangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis stod lung sba ra'i gzims khang gi me mtshams kyi ba gam bzhi pa rak+ta bzhad pa'i phyogs kyi tshes la sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i brgyud pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
